about: Lane per checker for the checkers whose languages include C in Coverity 2025.9.0 (cov-analyze --list-checkers; descriptions from doc/en/cov_checker_ref.html), and for eleven C++-only checkers, placed from the 2026.9.0 checker reference when a C++ analysis reported them. Other C++-only checkers have no row yet. A row with 'lane' is fixed: its findings take that lane with no inference. A row with 'lanes' lists the candidates: inference chooses among them per finding, by 'decide'. Rules and format: references/lanes.md and references/records.md.

ALLOC_FREE_MISMATCH.why: a resource reaches a freeing function that does not match its allocator

ARRAY_VS_SINGLETON.why: a pointer to one object reaches array indexing

ASSERT_SIDE_EFFECT.why: a side effect inside an assertion: the program changes when assertions are compiled out

ATOMICITY.why: two critical sections that should be one: wrong under some thread schedule

AUDIT.SPECULATIVE_EXECUTION_DATA_LEAK.why: an audit pattern for speculative-execution leaks

AUTO_CAUSES_COPY.why: a performance guideline: an auto declaration that copies a class object

BAD_ALLOC_STRLEN.why: strlen(p+1) as an allocation size is undefined for an empty string

BAD_COMPARE.why: a comparison whose result is fixed, such as a function's address against 0

BAD_FREE.why: a pointer that was not dynamically allocated reaches free

BAD_SHIFT.decide: Construction when the shift amount is wrong by its type or a constant; Value or path when the claim rests on a range found along a path

BAD_SIZEOF.why: sizeof of a suspicious operand (an address, a pointer) where the object's size looks meant

BUFFER_SIZE.decide: Construction when the declared sizes alone make the size argument wrong; Value or path when the claim rests on a length found along a path

CHAR_IO.why: a character-I/O result stored in a char cannot tell EOF from a valid byte

CHECKED_RETURN.why: a callee's error return is ignored

CHROOT.why: chroot() not followed by chdir(): the jail can be escaped

CONSTANT_EXPRESSION_RESULT.why: an expression with one possible value that looks meant to vary

COPY_INSTEAD_OF_MOVE.why: a performance guideline: a copy where a matching move is available

COPY_PASTE_ERROR.why: an incomplete change to copied code is suspected

CTOR_DTOR_LEAK.why: a constructor allocates into a field that the destructor does not free

DC.PREDICTABLE_KEY_PASSWORD.why: a don't-call list: key generation from caller-supplied seeds

DC.STREAM_BUFFER.why: a don't-call list: gets, scanf and fscanf

DC.STRING_BUFFER.why: a don't-call list: sprintf, sscanf, strcat, strcpy

DC.WEAK_CRYPTO.why: a don't-call list: weak pseudorandom generators

DEADCODE.why: code no value can reach: a deliberate defensive fallback, or a wrong condition

DIVIDE_BY_ZERO.why: a zero divisor along a path

ENUM_AS_BOOLEAN.why: an enum with more than two values used as a boolean

EVALUATION_ORDER.why: side effects in an unspecified order: the result depends on the compiler

EXPOSED_NON_CONST_STATIC.why: a coding rule: no public, static, non-const fields

FLOATING_POINT_EQUALITY.why: a coding rule: floating-point values are not tested for equality

FORMAT_STRING_INJECTION.why: untrusted data reaches a format string

FORWARD_NULL.why: a pointer tested against or set to NULL reaches a dereference

GLOBAL_INIT_ORDER.why: behaviour depends on the unspecified order of static initialization

HARDCODED_SECRET.why: a secret in the source; first check that the value really is a secret

IDENTICAL_BRANCHES.why: branches that do the same thing whatever the condition

INCOMPATIBLE_CAST.why: an object accessed through a pointer to an incompatible type

INCOMPLETE_DEALLOCATOR.why: a deallocator that releases less than its allocator acquired

INFINITE_LOOP.why: a loop whose condition's variables cannot change

INTEGER_OVERFLOW.decide: Construction when constant or type arithmetic overflows; Value or path when untrusted data reaches a sink through the overflow

INVALIDATE_ITERATOR.why: an iterator used after a change to its container invalidated it, or past its end

LOCK.why: a lock still held, or taken twice, along a path

MISSING_BREAK.why: a case falls through: deliberate, or a forgotten break

MISSING_COMMA.why: adjacent string literals concatenated where a comma looks meant

MISSING_LOCK.decide: Construction when the unlocked access is wrong under some thread schedule; Value or path when the claim is a lock state along a path

MISSING_MOVE_ASSIGNMENT.why: a performance guideline: copy assignment applied to rvalues in a class with no move assignment

MISSING_RESTORE.why: non-local state left altered along a path

MISSING_RETURN.why: a path reaches the end of a non-void function

MIXED_ENUMS.why: one symbol treated as two different enum types

NEGATIVE_RETURNS.decide: Contract when the negative value is a callee's return; Value or path when it is a variable tested negative along the path

NESTING_INDENT_MISMATCH.why: indentation that does not match the nesting

NON_POD_BYTE_ACCESS.why: memset or memcpy on an object whose non-POD type makes raw byte access unsafe

NO_EFFECT.why: a statement that does nothing, or not what it appears to

NULL_FIELD.why: a field that is usually tested for NULL reaches a dereference

NULL_RETURNS.why: a callee's NULL return is used

OPEN_ARGS.why: open() with O_CREAT and no mode: the file's permissions are unspecified

ORDER_REVERSAL.why: locks taken in different orders: deadlock under some thread schedule

OVERFLOW_BEFORE_WIDEN.decide: Construction when the operand types alone allow the overflow; Value or path when the claim rests on operand values found along a path

OVERLAPPING_COPY.why: a copy whose source and destination overlap

OVERRUN.why: an index or length found along a path exceeds a buffer

PARSE_ERROR.why: a capture problem, not a claim about the code: a question for the coverity skill

PASS_BY_VALUE.why: a performance guideline: large parameters passed by value

POINTER_NONDETERMINISM.why: unrelated pointers compared: the result is unspecified

PRECEDENCE_ERROR.why: operators grouped by precedence where the other grouping looks meant

PRINTF_ARGS.why: a format string and its arguments that do not match

READLINK.why: readlink()'s result used as a length or index without the check its contract needs

RESOURCE_LEAK.why: a resource still held at a function exit

RETURN_LOCAL.why: the address of a local returned: invalid as soon as the function returns

REVERSE_INULL.why: a pointer dereferenced before its null check: can it be NULL there?

REVERSE_NEGATIVE.why: an index used before its check for negative values

REVERSE_OVERRUN.why: an index used before its bounds check

SECURE_CODING.why: an audit list of calls to review (deprecated)

SECURE_TEMP.why: a temporary file created in a way an attacker can race

SIGN_EXTENSION.decide: Construction when the extension gives a wrong value for part of the input; Intent when the conversion is well-defined and the question is whether the author meant it

SIZECHECK.why: an allocation smaller than the pointer's target type

SIZEOF_MISMATCH.why: a sizeof that does not match the pointer beside it

SLEEP.why: a sleeping call made while a lock is held

STACK_USE.why: stack use over a configured threshold

STRAY_SEMICOLON.why: a semicolon that changes the logic

STREAM_FORMAT_STATE.why: a stream's format state left altered along a path

STRING_NULL.why: a string with no terminator reaches a string function

STRING_OVERFLOW.decide: Construction when the declared sizes alone allow the overflow; Value or path when the claim rests on a source length found along a path

STRING_SIZE.why: an untrusted string's length reaches a copy unchecked

SWAPPED_ARGUMENTS.why: arguments in an order that does not match the parameter names

TAINTED_SCALAR.why: an untrusted scalar reaches an index, a bound or a size unchecked

TAINTED_STRING.why: an untrusted string reaches a sink that trusts it

TOCTOU.why: a file checked and then used: wrong when it changes in between

UNCAUGHT_EXCEPT.why: an exception thrown along a call path that nothing catches, or that breaks an exception specification

UNEXPECTED_CONTROL_FLOW.why: a control-flow idiom with a likely mistaken meaning

UNINIT.why: a variable used before it is set

UNINIT_CTOR.why: a member the constructor leaves unset: set later on purpose, or forgotten

UNINTENDED_INTEGER_DIVISION.decide: Construction when the integer division gives a wrong value for part of the input; Intent when it is well-defined and the question is whether floating-point division was meant

UNNECESSARY_STRING_COPY.why: a performance guideline: an inefficient std::string pattern; the checker makes no correctness claim

UNREACHABLE.why: code no control flow can reach

UNSAFE_XML_PARSE_CONFIG.why: an XML parser configured to accept external entities and similar attacks

UNUSED_VALUE.why: a value stored and never used

USELESS_CALL.why: a call whose only effect is a result that is ignored

USER_POINTER.why: a user-space pointer dereferenced in the kernel

USE_AFTER_FREE.why: memory or a resource used after it is released

VARARGS.why: stdarg.h macros used in a way the standard leaves undefined

WEAK_GUARD.why: an authorization decision taken on spoofable data (host names, addresses)

WRAPPER_ESCAPE.why: a string wrapper's internal pointer used after the wrapper is destroyed

WRITE_CONST_FIELD.why: a write to a const-qualified field

Y2K38_SAFETY.why: a time_t narrowed to 32 bits: wrong for part of its range
